definitions.explanation: The period after a war. In Japanese without further specification, this almost always refers to the period after World War II, from Japan's surrender in 1945 onward. Used broadly for the social, political, and economic changes that followed.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}ましかった→目覚ましい：13628_mezamashii⟧。
{戦後|せんご}⟦{間|ま}もなく→間もなく：02491_mamonaku⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制定|せいてい}→制定：11907_seitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new constitution was established shortly after the war.

examples.japanese: {戦後|せんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高度経済成長|こうどけいざいせいちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間入|なかまい}り→仲間入り：07323_nakamairi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: Postwar Japan achieved developed-nation status through a period of rapid economic growth.

notes:
USAGE:
When used without qualification, {戦後|せんご} refers to the period after World War II (from 1945 onward). It is one of the most important temporal reference points in modern Japanese discourse. The expression {戦後|せんご}N⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (N years after the war) is used to mark anniversaries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦後|せんご}⟦{復興|ふっこう}→復興：07590_fukkou⟧: postwar recovery/reconstruction
- {戦後|せんご}⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧: postwar Japan
- {戦後|せんご}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: postwar education
- {戦後|せんご}⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧: postwar democracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{戦前|せんぜん}→戦前：12852_senzen⟧: prewar (before the war)
- {戦中|せんちゅう}: during the war, wartime
